long_description:
Three nights in a 3.5-acre Santa Fe-inspired sanctuary in the high desert. Designed for the woman who's been holding a lot for a long time and is ready to set it down for a few days. 

Less doing, more being.

What's included:

✨ Therapeutic yoga, breathwork, and yoga nidra 

✨ Group life coaching circles 

✨ Reiki 

✨ Sound healing 

✨ Guided hike through Joshua Tree National Park 

✨ Private stargazing 

✨ Every meal cooked by a private chef 

The villa: Outdoor yoga pavilion, indoor studio, saltwater pool, jacuzzi, labyrinth, rooftop patio, boulder fire pit, and wide open desert skies.

I'm Karley, an ICF-certified life coach and 500-hour yoga therapy specialist based in San Diego. This is my flagship retreat and I keep it small so every woman feels held. 🤍

Learn more: https://www.abrilliantlife.co/joshua-tree-retreat

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Irvine, Food & Drink events in Irvine.
